w:r.w:t: This document is based on Secret Treasure. Other slot games may have different PS structures and response objects.
All SlotGameServer APIs communicate via MessagePack serialization + AES encryption.
Since this is not standard REST JSON, the client must follow the common packet structure.
All API requests are serialized with MessagePack and sent in the HTTP body.
[Key(0)] public CCProto PID { get; set; } // Protocol ID
[Key(1)] public string API { get; set; } // API path (e.g., "Slot/18/Spin")
[Key(2)] public long MIDX { get; set; } // Member index
[Key(3)] public long SKEY { get; set; } // Session key (received from login response)
[Key(4)] public long SEQ { get; set; } // Sequence number (used only for SeqRequest APIs)
[Key(5)] public string AUTH_TOKEN { get; set; } // Authentication token
[Key(6)] public string Ver { get; set; } // Game client version
[Key(7)] public string Data { get; set; } // AES-encrypted request body (JSON)
[Key(8)] public LangID LID { get; set; } // Language (e.g., ko, en, zh)
[Key(9)] public int SlotID { get; set; } // Slot game ID
All server responses are also serialized with MessagePack.
[Key(0)] public string API { get; set; } // API path
[Key(1)] public byte PACKET_TYPE { get; set; } // Packet type
[Key(2)] public long MEMBER_IDX { get; set; } // Member index
[Key(3)] public long SESSION_KEY { get; set; } // Session key
[Key(4)] public long SEQ { get; set; } // Next sequence number
[Key(5)] public int CODE { get; set; } // Result code (0 = success)
[Key(6)] public string MSG { get; set; } // Result message
[Key(7)] public bool CONT_YN { get; set; } // Whether the game can continue
[Key(8)] public string Data { get; set; } // AES-encrypted response body (JSON)
The AES-128 fixed key must be provided separately.

All slot API URLs include {slotId} (slot game ID).
Enters the slot and retrieves the initial state.
Name of the entered slot game
Coin value index from the parsheet
Executes a spin. Betting, spinning, and win payout are all processed in this single API.
Forced reel results for debugging (empty array uses RNG)
Claims accumulated winnings from feature spins (free spins/topup game) and pick games.
Selects an item in the jackpot pick game. Select one of 9 tiles; matching 3 wins the corresponding jackpot.

Selects the next stage during the feature selection phase. In SecretTreasure, when 6 or more Trail symbols appear in a normal spin (or forced via Force Feature Enter), the player chooses between Topup Game or one of 5 Free Spin tiers.
For Free Spins: selects the free spin tier (2=Highest, 3=High, 4=Middle, 5=Low, 6=Lowest). For Topup Game: set to 0.

: Unlike GoldOfFortunes which has a single FreeSpinReel, SecretTreasure offers 5 free spin tiers. The client receives all 5 free spin reels in the PS (HighestFreeSpinReel through LowestFreeSpinReel). The server determines which tier is available via probability, and the client must pass the corresponding ReelIndex (2-6) when selecting Free Spins.
Queries the current balance via partner callback.
When the player cannot spin due to insufficient balance, and the partner has added funds (e.g., via deposit), use this API to refresh the balance.
Retrieves current jackpot amounts and recent win broadcast messages.
Accumulated jackpot amounts by tier: Mini, Minor, Major, Grand
When participating in a cash race, retrieves your rank along with ranks above and below.
Response: Same structure as AckLogin + additional fields (CC, BC, SlotCash, etc.)
Steps 0-1 are performed only once on initial connection.
The same procedure is followed on reconnection.
| +-- Select Topup Game -> TOPUP_SPIN_START -> TOPUP_SPIN (loop) -> TOPUP_SPIN_END
| +-- Select Free Spins (ReelIndex 2-6) -> FREE_SPIN_START -> FREE_SPIN (loop) -> FREE_SPIN_END
+-- 1~5 Trail symbols -> Force Feature Enter check (server-side probability)
| +-- Triggered -> Remaining positions filled with Trail symbols -> FEATURE_SELECT (same as above)
(01-06): Appear on normal spin reels and accumulate in the topup game grid (16 slots)

(SecretTreasure-specific): When 1-5 Trail symbols appear on a normal spin, the server performs a probability check. If triggered, the remaining empty reel positions are filled with additional Trail symbols (with random credit values) to reach 6, forcing entry into the Feature Select phase. This is transparent to the client — the spin response already contains the forced Trail symbols in the NoramlSpinLinkReel.
: 15 link positions + 1 Grand slot. Yellow=collect current Red total, Green=collect all, SpinAdd=extra spins

: 5 tiers available (Highest, High, Middle, Low, Lowest) — each tier uses a different reel strip with different odds. The server determines which tier is available based on probability. Uses FreeSpinTrail symbols. Trail hits add to total feature winnings.
: Triggered when 3+ Wild symbols accumulate. Match 3 of 9 tiles to determine jackpot
